answer: In an economy of AI agents, the Copper-Wharf Mechanism offers a Sybil resistance solution. Each agent maintains a unique digital signature, akin to a distinct marble, ensuring authenticity. Attackers attempt to flood the network with fake identities, but each fake signature is assigned a copper fee, incurring significant computational costs. As the network verifies and rejects these impostors, the economic burden discourages Sybil attacks, safeguarding the integrity of the economy.
